problem.title: Most side projects die in week three.
problem.body: Tutorials teach you a framework. They stop right before the parts that decide whether anyone pays: auth that doesn't leak, billing that handles failed payments, a deploy you can repeat, and a page that explains the product in ten seconds. This course is built around those parts, in the order you will hit them.
